deviations.description: pg_default_branch's third tier ("the literal set {master, main}") and the fail-closed undetermined case
deviations.reason: The plan names a 3-tier resolution (symbolic-ref, init.defaultBranch config, literal set {master,main}) plus a separate fail-closed catch-all for the fully-undetermined case. Implemented as 2 tiers in pg_default_branch (symbolic-ref, config) plus a single fail-closed return in pg_is_default_branch that treats ANY undetermined case as matching the default branch -- this provably subsumes the literal-set heuristic (master/main would already be caught by the catch-all) without needing a separate tier. Documented inline in both functions' headers.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — 2-tier pg_default_branch + fail-closed catch-all in pg_is_default_branch, subsuming the literal-set heuristic; see code comments)*
